items.description: Map the repository and research pipeline modules before any implementation
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/repository_map.md that lists every existing top-level repo path and explains the purpose, upstream inputs, downstream outputs, and status of README.md, .gitattributes, .gitignore, .archivara/semantic_scholar.py, .archivara/concept_evolve.py, .archivara/cache/semantic_scholar/, .archivara/logs/, results/research_context.*, results/literature/*, results/swarm/*, research_rubric.json, and the currently empty or future-facing results/verification/, results/concept_evolve/, and figures/ directories.

items.description: Translate saved swarm guidance into a pre-implementation direction memo
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/swarm/selection_memo.md after reading results/swarm/director_brief.md, results/swarm/hypotheses.json, and results/swarm/tool_plan.md; memo must explain why H1 is champion, H2 is backup, H3 is parked, and whether missing scout files remain a blocker that keeps novelty claims provisional.

items.description: Extend the saved literature snapshot with targeted web search for actual gravity-sim prior art
items.acceptance_criteria: Starting from results/literature/literature_snapshot.json and results/literature/semantic_scholar_manifest.json, use .archivara/semantic_scholar.py search or graph plus targeted web search and repository/code search for Newtonian/orbital/N-body simulator papers and codebases; update the snapshot instead of replacing it, record the new queries in the manifest, add at least 10 directly relevant papers and 3 code repositories, and explicitly mark at least 5 off-domain watchlist hits as query drift.

items.description: Create and maintain sources.bib as the canonical bibliography
items.acceptance_criteria: Create sources.bib in the repo root with BibTeX entries for every consulted paper, code repository, benchmark spec, and official documentation source; include at least 10 relevant gravity-sim papers from the corrected review and ensure every cited artifact in later phases has a matching BibTeX entry.

items.description: Run concept-tree exploration and a multi-agent novelty-correction pass
items.acceptance_criteria: Run .archivara/concept_evolve.py evolve on the corrected gravity-sim problem statement, produce results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json, adjacency.json, and walk_paths.json, then delegate explorer, hypothesis_scout, and citation_auditor in parallel and synthesize their outputs into results/concept_evolve/tree/selection_notes.md and results/literature/prior_art_gap.md; the gap file must contain differentiation notes for 'Conventional and recent advances in gravity separation technologies for coal cleaning: A systematic and critical review', 'Relaxation of experimental parameters in a quantum-gravity-induced entanglement of masses protocol using electromagnetic screening', 'Yukawa-Casimir Wormholes in f(Q) Gravity', 'Numerical Modeling of the Excitation, Propagation, and Dissipation of Primary and Secondary Gravity Waves during Wintertime at McMurdo Station in the Antarctic', and at least 3 directly relevant gravity-sim systems from the corrected search.

items.description: Specify the baseline simulator architecture and module boundaries
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/baseline/architecture.md defining the baseline module graph for state representation, force model, integrator interface, scenario loader, invariant monitor, logging/replay, and visualization hooks, with one dependency diagram and one paragraph on how the code modules will consume the Phase 1 literature and swarm artifacts.

items.description: Choose baseline methods and write a comparator matrix before coding
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/baseline/baseline_matrix.md with at least 3 baselines: a fixed-step symplectic method, a close-encounter or hybrid baseline, and a high-accuracy reference baseline; for each, document expected strengths, failure modes, configuration ranges, and which Phase 4 metrics will judge it.

items.description: Define the canonical benchmark scenario pack and metric set
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/benchmarks/scenario_spec.md containing at least the 3 director-brief scenarios: long-horizon secular system, close encounter or scattering, and high-eccentricity passage; include initial condition sources, horizon lengths, timestep or precision sweeps, and the exact formulas for energy drift, angular-momentum drift, encounter-detection lead time, intervention precision or recall, and replay agreement.

items.description: Establish reproducibility rules and pass-fail metric contracts
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/benchmarks/metric_contract.md that defines seeds, runtime metadata, hardware metadata, deterministic replay tolerance, acceptable numerical tolerance, and explicit pass-fail thresholds for every metric in item_008.

items.description: Run a multi-agent baseline planning review before implementation
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate worker, benchmark_auditor, and monitor in parallel and synthesize the result into results/benchmarks/baseline_review.md; the review must confirm that the scenario pack, baseline matrix, and metric contract can falsify H1 and H2, list at least 3 risks, and identify any missing artifact that blocks coding.

items.description: Choose the primary research direction using corrected literature instead of ad hoc local preference
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/research_direction.md that explicitly references results/swarm/hypotheses.json, results/swarm/tool_plan.md, results/swarm/selection_memo.md, sources.bib, and results/literature/prior_art_gap.md; the memo must state whether H1 remains champion or H2 is promoted, with kill criteria and pivot conditions.

items.description: Design the self-diagnosing orchestration layer for cross-regime gravity simulation
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/design/orchestration_spec.md defining unsafe-regime triggers, close-encounter detection, timestep inadequacy detection, precision escalation rules, solver handoff semantics, and human-readable intervention logs; every trigger must map to at least one measurable metric from results/benchmarks/metric_contract.md.

items.description: Preserve a documented backup path for deterministic replay and fidelity envelopes
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/design/replay_fidelity_spec.md defining the determinism contract, replay hash or checksum policy, fidelity envelope definition, runtime assumptions, and the exact conditions under which H2 supersedes H1 if the orchestration novelty claim fails.

items.description: Probe, reframe, iterate, and walk the concept tree before locking the design
items.acceptance_criteria: Run .archivara/concept_evolve.py probe, reframe, iterate, and walk for the chosen direction; update results/concept_evolve/probe_result.json, reframings.json, bridge_candidates.json, concept_delta.json, recurrent_state.json, walk_session.json, and results/concept_evolve/tree/selection_notes.md with at least 3 retained branches, 2 retired branches, and one champion branch tied to a concrete experiment obligation.

items.description: Run a multi-agent novelty and falsification review on the chosen design
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate hypothesis_scout, falsifier, novelty_checker, and integrator in parallel and synthesize the result into results/verification/novelty_report.md while refreshing results/literature/prior_art_gap.md; the report must compare the planned method against the named watchlist papers, at least 3 directly relevant gravity-sim systems from sources.bib, and conclude survives, provisional, or killed with evidence.

items.description: Write the closed-set experiment plan for the champion direction only
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/plan.md enumerating the exact runs, scenario order, ablations, and captured artifacts for the selected champion direction plus the approved baselines; the plan must stay closed-set unless a documented kill criterion promotes the backup.

items.description: Define the per-run result schema before any experiment is executed
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/result_schema.json documenting required fields for run_id, scenario, solver, timestep or precision policy, intervention events, invariant metrics, hardware or runtime metadata, seed, replay hash, and citation keys to the compared prior work.

items.description: Prepare a prior-work comparison matrix for every evaluation claim
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/comparison_matrix.md that maps each planned metric to at least one paper or system in sources.bib; include at least 5 comparison rows spanning integrator behavior, replay, diagnostics, uncertainty, or failure detection, and label each row as direct, partial, or qualitative comparison.

items.description: Define the falsification protocol for negative or ambiguous experiment outcomes
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/experiments/falsification_protocol.md that states when H1 is killed, when H2 is promoted, how to separate numerical instability from implementation bugs, and which artifacts must be updated after a failed run, including results/research_context.md and results/literature/prior_art_gap.md.

items.description: Run a multi-agent experiment-readiness and benchmark audit
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate worker, monitor, benchmark_auditor, and falsifier in parallel and synthesize the result into results/verification/benchmark_report.md; the report must check scenario coverage, metric completeness, replay logging, and whether the experiment plan can decisively support or refute the novelty claim.

items.description: Write the analysis plan that links evidence back to novelty, reliability, and usability claims
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/analysis_plan.md that maps each hypothesis claim to evidence artifacts, failure cases, and comparison sources from sources.bib, with dedicated sections for novelty, reliability, usability, and limitations.

items.description: Keep the shared context and prior-art gap artifacts current throughout the run
items.acceptance_criteria: Update results/research_context.md and results/literature/prior_art_gap.md after every major phase so they reflect the current stage, known paper count, chosen direction, blocker status, differentiation notes, evidence artifacts, and pivot decisions; no placeholder subsection may remain once evidence exists.

items.description: Prepare the figure, table, and artifact inventory for reproducible reporting
items.acceptance_criteria: Create results/analysis/figure_table_plan.md listing every planned figure or table, its source artifact, metric, caption stub, and dependency chain, and document a naming convention for future outputs under figures/.

items.description: Produce the specialist novelty-market verification packet under results/verification
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate citation_auditor, benchmark_auditor, novelty_checker, and integrator in parallel and produce results/verification/citation_audit.md, results/verification/benchmark_report.md, results/verification/novelty_report.md, and results/verification/verification_summary.md; the summary must state pass or fail for citation coverage, benchmark adequacy, novelty differentiation, external positioning, and unresolved blockers.

items.description: Run a multi-agent final synthesis and documentation gate before any external write-up
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate writer, reviewer, and integrator in parallel and synthesize the result into results/analysis/final_storyboard.md; the storyboard must include the final claim scope, threat-to-validity checklist, required citations, artifact inventory, and a release gate that blocks publication if item_015, item_020, or item_024 fail.
